_comment: Specification data for the 3D restaurant planning section (FF&E, lighting, equipment and finishes schedules). Values starting with 't:' are vocabulary keys translated in assets/i18n/restaurant-spec.json; anything else is shown as written. 'match' links an object to its instances in the 3D model (assets/data/restaurant-plan.json) so quantities and click targets come from the model; objects without a model instance give 'zones' + 'quantity'. Budgets are [min, max, per] in EUR — INDICATIVE PLACEHOLDERS for the concept stage, not quotes. Manufacturers and suppliers stay 'tbc' until real project data replaces them.
